title: Yueh-ya (Sam) Hsu
text:
About
I am a PhD student at the Harris School of Public Policy at the University of Chicago. My research studies refugee welfare in developing countries, using randomized field experiments. My current work includes projects in Bangladesh and Uganda.
I’ve joined the current cohort of the Charity Entrepreneurship Incubation Program. I will be in London from mid-September to mid-October. Please reach out if you would like to meet!
